title: FreshMem: Brain-Inspired Frequency-Space Hybrid Memory for Streaming Video Understanding
abstract: arXiv:2602.01683v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Transitioning Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) from offline to online streaming video understanding is essential for continuous perception. However, existing methods lack flexible adaptivity, leading to irreversible detail loss and context fragmentation. To resolve this, we propose FreshMem, a Frequency-Space Hybrid Memory network inspired by the brain's logarithmic perception and memory consolidation. FreshMem reconciles short-term fidelity with long-term coherence through two synergistic modules: Multi-scale Frequency Memory (MFM), which projects overflowing frames into representative frequency coefficients, complemented by residual details to reconstruct a global historical "gist"; and Space Thumbnail Memory (STM), which discretizes the continuous stream into episodic clusters by employing an adaptive compression strategy to distill them into high-density space thumbnails. translated_title: FreshMem：面向流式视频理解的脑启发频率-空间混合记忆网络
translated_abstract: 将多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）从离线转向在线流式视频理解对于持续感知至关重要。然而，现有方法缺乏灵活的适应性，导致不可逆的细节丢失和上下文碎片化。为解决这一问题，我们提出了FreshMem，一种受大脑对数感知和记忆巩固机制启发的频率-空间混合记忆网络。FreshMem通过两个协同模块来调和短期保真度与长期连贯性：多尺度频率记忆（MFM），将溢出的帧投影为具有代表性的频率系数，并结合残差细节以重建全局历史的“要义”；以及空间缩略图记忆（STM），通过自适应压缩策略将连续视频流离散化为情节聚类，并将其提炼为高密度的空间缩略图。大量实验表明，FreshMem显著……
tldr: FreshMem受大脑对数感知与记忆巩固机制启发，通过多尺度频率记忆（MFM）和空间缩略图记忆（STM）两个协同模块，在流式视频理解中同时兼顾短期细节保真与长期上下文连贯，解决了现有方法细节丢失和上下文碎片化的问题。
en_tdlr: FreshMem is a brain-inspired frequency-space hybrid memory network that reconciles short-term fidelity with long-term coherence in streaming video understanding through synergistic Multi-scale Frequency Memory (MFM) and Space Thumbnail Memory (STM) modules, addressing irreversible detail loss and context fragmentation.
